tasks.short: File loan records the clerk accepted.

steps.what: Keep records the system already stores.

tasks.design: The loan system already stores the record. That time is not the clerk's. The clerk reviews what must be maintained, accepts it, and {DOCS} files that version. A document is not filed because a model classified it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Papers were dropped into a folder, and the system of record was updated again by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: The system already keeps the loan record. Filing a document the clerk has accepted can follow that acceptance.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding that a record is complete enough to file stays with the clerk.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk maintains and accepts the record. Storage the system already does is not their saving.
tasks.altitude: The clerk still reviews and accepts a record before it is filed. Storage the system already does is not saved labour.

reach.task: Read a record the clerk accepted and filed
reach.learn: The file is not a new credit decision

evidence.claim: Storage a loan system already does is not saved human labour. Filing a record still waits for the person who maintains it to accept that version.
Applicant financial data is personal data, used for the application the person is making. It is sent only in a version the clerk has accepted. National rules on credit references differ.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a record needs filing and ends when the accepted version is on file. The clerk maintains it. Existing storage is excluded.
The fields are the record id and their acceptance. The system produces the stored record. The clerk produces the acceptance. If the record is incomplete, they do not file it.
The prior classes this task as automate. The steps agree a file of an accepted record can move. They exclude storage the system already does, and they keep the review.
unknowns: Whether the loan system already stores these records.
Which papers never enter that system and stay in the clerk's hands.
research_questions: Does the loan system already store these records?
Which papers never enter that system and stay in the clerk's hands?

already_counted.description: The remaining review on this step stays with the loan clerk
The whole step stays with the loan clerk

incremental.description: Keep the filing checklist aligned with the record types

approvals.approved_version: loan record the loan clerk accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the system does not already store the record, that storage is not a saving, and the low end is the review and the acceptance, which stay either way. 18 percent is work the system already does and is not saved human labour. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check references and file the accepted note.

steps.what: Check personal references with those sources.

tasks.design: The clerk contacts the bureau, the employer, and the other sources, and checks the personal references. They write what was said and accept that note. {DOCS} files that version. Nothing scores the applicant. The calls are not recorded. A bureau report, if one is already on file, is read by the clerk. It is not a decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The calls were the work, and the note was typed afterwards.
tasks.enabler_now: A note the clerk has accepted can be filed. The contact itself cannot be skipped.
tasks.still_hard: What a bureau, an employer, or a referee says, and what it means, stay with the clerk.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk makes the contact and accepts the note. A report does not decide the loan.
tasks.altitude: The contacts stay in full. Only the note they accepted is filed. Nothing scores the applicant.

reach.task: Read a references note the clerk accepted
reach.learn: The note is not a credit score

evidence.claim: Checking credit and personal references means contacting the source. A report already on file can be read by the clerk. It does not score the applicant and it does not decide the loan.

A decision on credit that has a legal effect on a person must not be taken by a system alone. A person decides. This design does not score an applicant, does not set a credit limit, and does not grant an extension.
Applicant financial data is personal data, used for the application the person is making. It is sent only in a version the clerk has accepted. National rules on credit references differ.

assumptions: The workflow starts when references must be checked and ends when the accepted note is on file. The clerk makes the contact. Calls are not recorded. Nothing scores the applicant.
The fields are what the source said, as the clerk wrote it, and their acceptance. The source produces the words. The clerk writes them. If a source does not answer, the note says so.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the contact stays.
unknowns: Whether a bureau report is already on file for this applicant.
Whether the applicant has consented to these contacts.
research_questions: Is a bureau report already on file for this applicant?
Has the applicant consented to these contacts?
